in_marathi.name: Kismat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kismat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The term Kismat refers to the belief in predetermined fate and the supernatural influence of the stars and planets on human life. It is derived from the Arabic word 'qismat' meaning 'portion' or 'lot'. The name is used to signify that the person is blessed with good fortune and is protected by the divine.
